correctness.rationale: For each off-diagonal abba, its unique exact-two central b-run costs +1 and the q diagonal aaaa require +3 each. For q≥3 both aba and bab force \(m_{ab}\ge3\) in a closed proper run skeleton; Euler parity forces at least \(q/2\) extra edges for even q. \(q=2\) uses four distinct required runs. Thus \(L\ge(5q^2+q)/2\) for odd q and \(L\ge(5q^2+2q)/2\) for even q. A connected Euler circuit of K_q (plus a matching if q even) expanded into alternating 3-edge segments on first pair uses realizes all q² targets with equality. Equality makes every run count and adjacency multiplicity sharp. Independent finite BFS exactly confirms \(q=2\),3; the all-q result rests on the proof, not the test.

value.rationale: The shortest repeated-factor coverage of all \(q^2\) four-symbol palindromes is a natural constrained circular superstring invariant. An exact all-q optimum and forced optimum run and parity profiles are mathematically informative beyond the single known binary linear case; the even-alphabet jump is an explicit structural obstruction. This is a modest but complete family classification, not a claim of a new universal-cycle principle or a general even-palindrome theorem.
